
```{python}
#| label: fig-knowledge-galaxy
#| fig-cap: "SSCCS Knowledge Graph Topology: Indexed from docs.ssccs.org"
import json
import requests
import math
import random
import numpy as np
import re
import networkx as nx
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load remote search.json
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
URL = "https://docs.ssccs.org/search.json"
try:
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Failed to load {URL}: {e}")
    raise

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Node and edge collection (expansion)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
nodes = {}
edges = []  # Each edge is {"from": str, "to": str, "type": str}

# Temporary storage: record which crumbs each objectID has (for sibling relationship extraction)
node_to_parents = {}  # {child_id: set of parent_ids}
node_to_crumbs = {}   # {node_id: list of crumbs}

for item in data:
    obj_id = item.get("objectID")
    if not obj_id:
        continue
    title = item.get("title", "")
    # Strip placeholder titles starting with "-"
    if title.startswith("-"):
        title = title.lstrip("- ").strip() or obj_id
    crumbs = item.get("crumbs", [])
    text = item.get("text", "")[:500]
    nodes[obj_id] = {"title": title, "crumbs": crumbs, "preview": text}
    node_to_crumbs[obj_id] = crumbs

    # Hierarchical relationship (PARENT_OF)
    for i in range(len(crumbs) - 1):
        parent = crumbs[i]
        child = crumbs[i+1]
        edges.append({"from": parent, "to": child, "type": "PARENT_OF"})
        # Save parent-child mappings (for sibling relationships)
        node_to_parents.setdefault(child, set()).add(parent)

    # Link Extraction (CITES)
    link_pattern = r'\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)'
    for match in re.finditer(link_pattern, text):
        link_href = match.group(2)
        # Internal links only (relative path or starting with /)
        if link_href.startswith("/") or link_href.startswith("./"):
            # Simply use href as objectID (based on filename)
            target = link_href.split("#")[0].lstrip("./").replace(".html", "")
            if target:
                edges.append({"from": obj_id, "to": target, "type": "CITES"})

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Identify Note nodes (de-emphasized leaves)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Detect by objectID path: Notes/ or notes/
# These are peripheral content, not core specification.
def _is_note(oid: str) -> bool:
    lower = oid.lower()
    return lower.startswith("notes/") or "/notes/" in lower or lower.startswith("note_")

for nid in list(nodes.keys()):
    nodes[nid]["is_note"] = _is_note(nid)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Add sibling relationship (SIBLING)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# parent -> list of children
parent_to_children = {}
for child, parents in node_to_parents.items():
    for parent in parents:
        parent_to_children.setdefault(parent, []).append(child)

for parent, children in parent_to_children.items():
    for i in range(len(children)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(children)):
            edges.append({"from": children[i], "to": children[j], "type": "SIBLING"})

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Graph construction and semantic depth
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
G = nx.DiGraph()
G.add_nodes_from(nodes.keys())
for e in edges:
    G.add_edge(e["from"], e["to"])

# Roots: authoritative documents only — exclude Notes/
roots = [
    n for n in G.nodes()
    if G.in_degree(n) == 0 and not nodes.get(n, {}).get("is_note", False)
]
if not roots:
    roots = [n for n in G.nodes() if G.in_degree(n) == 0]
if not roots:
    roots = [list(G.nodes())[0]]

# Semantic depth: shortest path from core roots
# Notes that only connect via Note-to-Note links get no path → assigned max depth
depth = {}
for node in G.nodes():
    max_dist = 0
    for root in roots:
        try:
            dist = nx.shortest_path_length(G, source=root, target=node)
            if dist > max_dist:
                max_dist = dist
        except nx.NetworkXNoPath:
            continue
    depth[node] = max_dist

# Nodes unreachable from core roots get assigned one level deeper than max
reachable = [d for d in depth.values() if d > 0]
max_reachable = max(reachable) if reachable else 1
for node in depth:
    if depth[node] == 0 and node not in roots:
        depth[node] = max_reachable + 1

max_depth = max(depth.values()) if depth else 1

# Semantic importance: PageRank (more citations = more central)
pagerank = nx.pagerank(G, alpha=0.85)
pr_min = min(pagerank.values())
pr_max = max(pagerank.values())
pr_range = pr_max - pr_min if pr_max > pr_min else 1.0

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. 3D coordinate placement — spherical cloud
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
random.seed(42)
np.random.seed(42)

node_list = sorted(G.nodes())

# Spherical coordinates: radius varies by depth (inner = core, outer = Notes),
# theta/phi are random for even distribution on the sphere surface.
rng = random.Random(42)
node_theta = {node: rng.random() * 2 * math.pi for node in node_list}
node_phi   = {node: math.acos(2 * rng.random() - 1) for node in node_list}

pos = {}
for node in node_list:
    d = depth[node]
    pr = pagerank.get(node, 0.0)
    pr_norm = (pr - pr_min) / pr_range  # 0..1
    is_note = nodes.get(node, {}).get("is_note", False)

    # Radius: core docs inner, Notes outer — wide spread
    if is_note:
        r = 8.0 + rng.random() * 6.0
    else:
        r = 3.0 + d * 3.0 + pr_norm * 1.5

    theta = node_theta[node]
    phi = node_phi[node]

    x = r * math.sin(phi) * math.cos(theta)
    y = r * math.sin(phi) * math.sin(theta)
    z = r * math.cos(phi)
    x += np.random.normal(0, 0.5)
    y += np.random.normal(0, 0.5)
    z += np.random.normal(0, 0.5)
    pos[node] = (x, y, z)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Plotly trace — edge styling by semantic role
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
edge_traces = []

# CITES: semantic connections — dark amber
edge_styles = {
    "CITES": {"color": "#8b4513", "width": 2.5, "opacity": 0.85},
    "SIBLING": {"color": "#2d5a2d", "width": 0.6, "opacity": 0.4},
    "PARENT_OF": {"color": "#666666", "width": 0.5, "opacity": 0.3},
}

for etype in ["CITES", "SIBLING", "PARENT_OF"]:
    style = edge_styles[etype]
    x_vals, y_vals, z_vals = [], [], []
    for e in edges:
        if e["type"] != etype:
            continue
        u, v = e["from"], e["to"]
        if u not in pos or v not in pos:
            continue
        x0, y0, z0 = pos[u]
        x1, y1, z1 = pos[v]
        x_vals += [x0, x1, None]
        y_vals += [y0, y1, None]
        z_vals += [z0, z1, None]
    if x_vals:
        edge_traces.append(go.Scatter3d(
            x=x_vals, y=y_vals, z=z_vals,
            mode='lines',
            line=dict(color=style["color"], width=style["width"]),
            opacity=style["opacity"],
            name=etype,
            hoverinfo='none'
        ))

# Separate node traces: core docs vs Notes
core_x, core_y, core_z = [], [], []
core_colors, core_sizes, core_hover = [], [], []
note_x, note_y, note_z = [], [], []
note_colors, note_sizes, note_hover = [], [], []

for node in node_list:
    is_note = nodes.get(node, {}).get("is_note", False)
    x, y, z = pos[node]
    d = depth[node]
    pr = pagerank.get(node, 0.0)
    pr_norm = (pr - pr_min) / pr_range
    info = nodes.get(node, {})
    title = info.get("title", node)
    preview = info.get("preview", "")
    if preview:
        preview = preview[:200] + "\u2026" if len(preview) > 200 else preview
        ht = f"<b>{title}</b><br>{preview}"
    else:
        ht = f"<b>{title}</b>"

    if is_note:
        note_x.append(x); note_y.append(y); note_z.append(z)
        note_colors.append("rgb(100,100,100)")
        note_sizes.append(6)
        note_hover.append(ht)
    else:
        core_x.append(x); core_y.append(y); core_z.append(z)
        # Core node color: grayscale — shallow = light, deep = dark
        intensity = 0.1 + 0.5 * (d / max_depth) if max_depth > 0 else 0.3
        v = int(60 + 140 * (1 - intensity))
        core_colors.append(f'rgb({v},{v},{v})')
        # Core node size: base 10 + PageRank boost (max 20)
        core_sizes.append(10 + pr_norm * 10)
        core_hover.append(ht)

core_trace = go.Scatter3d(
    x=core_x, y=core_y, z=core_z,
    mode='markers',
    marker=dict(
        size=core_sizes,
        color=core_colors,
        symbol='circle',
        line=dict(width=0.3, color='rgba(0,0,0,0.5)')
    ),
    text=core_hover,
    hoverinfo='text',
    name='Core documents'
)

note_trace = go.Scatter3d(
    x=note_x, y=note_y, z=note_z,
    mode='markers',
    marker=dict(
        size=note_sizes,
        color=note_colors,
        symbol='circle',
        line=dict(width=0, color='rgba(0,0,0,0)')
    ),
    text=note_hover,
    hoverinfo='text',
    name='Notes',
    opacity=1.0
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Final layout
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
fig = go.Figure(data=edge_traces + [core_trace, note_trace])

azim_deg, elev_deg = 45, -20
azim_rad = azim_deg * math.pi / 180
elev_rad = elev_deg * math.pi / 180
r_cam = 1.5
eye_x = r_cam * math.cos(elev_rad) * math.sin(azim_rad)
eye_y = r_cam * math.cos(elev_rad) * math.cos(azim_rad)
eye_z = r_cam * math.sin(elev_rad)

fig.update_layout(
    scene=dict(
        xaxis=dict(showbackground=False, gridcolor='lightgray', zerolinecolor='black', title=''),
        yaxis=dict(showbackground=False, gridcolor='lightgray', zerolinecolor='black', title=''),
        zaxis=dict(showbackground=False, gridcolor='lightgray', zerolinecolor='black', title=''),
        aspectmode='cube',
        aspectratio=dict(x=1, y=1, z=1),
        camera=dict(eye=dict(x=eye_x, y=eye_y, z=eye_z), center=dict(x=0, y=0, z=0))
    ),
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0),
    showlegend=False
)

fig.show(config={'displayModeBar': False})
```
